<!--
================================================================================
  GOAL
  ----
  Assess the stability of PD Clustering on MovieLens 1M user embeddings
  (64, 128, 256 dimensions) across k = 2:4 clusters, using bootstrap
  resampling. For each (embedding, k) combination, PDC is re-fitted on
  n_boot subsampled replicates and compared to the full-data reference
  partition via Adjusted Rand Index (ARI).

  HOW IT WORKS
  ------------
  1. Settings   – Define embedding paths, k values, and bootstrap parameters.
                  All tuning knobs are in one place for easy adjustment.
  2. Helpers    – Utility functions for loading the cached best PD result,
                  drawing bootstrap samples, computing ARI against the
                  reference partition, and computing Silhouette / CH on the
                  bootstrap sample.
  3. Main loop  – For each (embedding, k):
                    a. Load the reference PD partition from cache.
                    b. If a bootstrap cache exists, load it; otherwise run
                       n_boot replicates, each on a random sample_fraction
                       subsample of users, and save the result.
                    c. Summarise each replicate's ARI, Silhouette, and CH.
  4. Output     – Bind summaries into one data frame, print, and write to CSV.
  5. Plot       – Line plot of mean bootstrap ARI by k, faceted by embedding.
  6. Inspect    – Print per-replicate detail for one (embedding, k) pair.

  RUNTIME BUDGET (basic Dell PC, ~2 hr target)
  ---------------------------------------------
  3 embeddings × 3 k values × 15 bootstraps = 135 PDC fits.
  Each fit runs on 30% of ~6 000 users (≈ 1 800 rows).
  Estimated fit time per replicate: ~10–30 s depending on dimensionality.
  Worst-case total: 135 × 30 s ≈ 67 min. Well within the 2-hour window.

  To speed up further: reduce n_boot or sample_fraction.
  To improve precision: increase n_boot (adds ~30 s per additional replicate).
================================================================================
-->

# 1. Requirements
```{r requirements}
required_packages <- c(
  "readr", "dplyr", "tidyr", "ggplot2",
  "mclust", "cluster", "clusterCrit", "FPDclustering"
)

installed    <- rownames(installed.packages())
missing_pkgs <- setdiff(required_packages, installed)

if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_pkgs)
}

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(mclust)        # adjustedRandIndex()
library(cluster)       # silhouette()
library(clusterCrit)   # intCriteria() for Calinski-Harabasz
library(FPDclustering) # PDC()
```

# 2. Settings
```{r settings}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# SETTINGS — all tuning knobs live here
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Embedding files to assess
embedding_paths <- c(
  "output/embeddings/user_embeddings_64.csv",
  "output/embeddings/user_embeddings_128.csv",
  "output/embeddings/user_embeddings_256.csv"
)

# k values to test
k_to_compare <- c(2, 3, 4)

# ── Bootstrap parameters ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
n_boot            <- 15    # number of bootstrap replicates
bootstrap_replace <- TRUE  # sample with replacement
sample_fraction   <- 0.30  # fit each replicate on 30% of users

set.seed(123)  # reproducible bootstrap draws

# Output directories
dir.create("output/bootstrap_stability_results", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("output/bootstrap_stability_cache",   recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# 3. Helpers
```{r helpers}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# HELPERS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Load the cached PD result for one (embedding_tag, k) combination.
# Returns NULL if no cache file is found.
load_cached_pd_for_k <- function(embedding_tag, k_val,
                                 cache_dir = "output/pd_cache") {
  cache_file <- file.path(
    cache_dir,
    paste0("pd_", embedding_tag, "_k", k_val, ".rds")
  )

  if (!file.exists(cache_file)) return(NULL)

  readRDS(cache_file)
}

# Draw a bootstrap sample of row indices from 1:n.
# Returns at least 2 indices (required for silhouette and ARI to be defined).
bootstrap_indices <- function(n, replace = TRUE, fraction = 0.30) {
  sample(seq_len(n), size = max(2, floor(fraction * n)), replace = replace)
}

# Compute ARI between the full-data reference labels and the bootstrap labels,
# restricted to the unique users that appear in the bootstrap sample.
# Returns NA if fewer than 2 unique users or fewer than 2 distinct clusters.
bootstrap_ari_vs_reference <- function(reference_labels, boot_labels, sampled_idx) {
  sampled_unique <- sort(unique(sampled_idx))

  if (length(sampled_unique) < 2) return(NA_real_)

  boot_first_pos     <- match(sampled_unique, sampled_idx)
  boot_labels_unique <- boot_labels[boot_first_pos]
  ref_labels_unique  <- reference_labels[sampled_unique]

  if (length(unique(boot_labels_unique)) < 2 ||
      length(unique(ref_labels_unique))  < 2) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  adjustedRandIndex(ref_labels_unique, boot_labels_unique)
}

# Compute average Silhouette Width for a bootstrap sample.
# Returns NA if fewer than 2 distinct clusters.
compute_avg_silhouette <- function(x, labels) {
  if (length(unique(labels)) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  dmat <- dist(x)
  sil  <- silhouette(as.integer(labels), dmat)
  mean(sil[, 3])
}

# Compute Calinski-Harabasz index for a bootstrap sample.
# Returns NA if fewer than 2 distinct clusters.
compute_ch <- function(x, labels) {
  if (length(unique(labels)) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  intCriteria(
    traj = x,
    part = as.integer(labels),
    crit = "Calinski_Harabasz"
  )$calinski_harabasz
}
```

# 4. Main bootstrap loop
```{r main}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# MAIN LOOP — PD Clustering only
# ------------------------------------------------------------

bootstrap_results <- list()

for (embedding_path in embedding_paths) {

  if (!file.exists(embedding_path)) {
    cat("Missing embedding file:", embedding_path, "\n")
    next
  }

  embedding_tag    <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(embedding_path))
  cat("\nProcessing:", embedding_tag, "\n")

  # Load and scale the embedding matrix; first column is UserID
  embeddings       <- read_csv(embedding_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  user_ids         <- embeddings[[1]]
  embedding_matrix <- scale(as.matrix(embeddings[, -1]))
  n                <- nrow(embedding_matrix)

  for (k_val in k_to_compare) {
    cat("  Bootstrapping PD Clustering for k =", k_val, "\n")

    # Load the reference (full-data) PD partition from the clustering notebook
    pd_cached <- load_cached_pd_for_k(
      embedding_tag = embedding_tag,
      k_val         = k_val,
      cache_dir     = "output/pd_cache"
    )

    if (is.null(pd_cached)) {
      cat("    Missing PD cache for k =", k_val, "— skipping\n")
      next
    }

    pd_reference_labels <- pd_cached$labels

    if (length(pd_reference_labels) != n) {
      cat("    Label length mismatch for", embedding_tag, "k =", k_val, "— skipping\n")
      next
    }

    # Per-(embedding, k) bootstrap cache file
    boot_cache_file <- file.path(
      "output/bootstrap_stability_cache",
      paste0("bootstrap_pd_", embedding_tag, "_k", k_val, ".rds")
    )

    if (file.exists(boot_cache_file)) {
      # ── Cache hit: skip re-running all replicates ────────────────────────
      cat("    Loading cached bootstrap results for", embedding_tag, "k =", k_val, "\n")
      boot_summary <- readRDS(boot_cache_file)

    } else {
      # ── Cache miss: run n_boot replicates ────────────────────────────────
      pd_boot_ari    <- rep(NA_real_, n_boot)
      pd_boot_sil    <- rep(NA_real_, n_boot)
      pd_boot_ch     <- rep(NA_real_, n_boot)
      pd_status      <- rep("ok", n_boot)

      for (b in seq_len(n_boot)) {
        cat("    Replicate", b, "of", n_boot, "\n")

        # Draw a subsample (30% of users by default)
        sampled_idx <- bootstrap_indices(
          n        = n,
          replace  = bootstrap_replace,
          fraction = sample_fraction
        )
        x_boot <- embedding_matrix[sampled_idx, , drop = FALSE]

        # Fit PDC on the bootstrap subsample.
        # Errors are caught so one bad replicate does not abort the loop.
        pd_model_boot <- tryCatch(
          suppressWarnings(
            PDC(x_boot, k = k_val)
          ),
          error = function(e) {
            pd_status[b] <<- paste("error:", conditionMessage(e))
            NULL
          }
        )

        if (!is.null(pd_model_boot)) {
          pd_labels_boot <- pd_model_boot$label

          # ARI vs. full-data reference partition (restricted to sampled users)
          pd_boot_ari[b] <- bootstrap_ari_vs_reference(
            reference_labels = pd_reference_labels,
            boot_labels      = pd_labels_boot,
            sampled_idx      = sampled_idx
          )

          # Within-bootstrap quality metrics
          pd_boot_sil[b] <- compute_avg_silhouette(x_boot, pd_labels_boot)
          pd_boot_ch[b]  <- compute_ch(x_boot, pd_labels_boot)
        }
      }

      # Collect everything into a summary object and cache it
      boot_summary <- list(
        embedding                = embedding_tag,
        k                        = k_val,
        n_boot                   = n_boot,
        bootstrap_replace        = bootstrap_replace,
        sample_fraction          = sample_fraction,
        pd_reference_silhouette  = pd_cached$avg_silhouette,
        pd_reference_ch          = pd_cached$ch,
        pd_reference_prob_silh   = pd_cached$prob_silh,
        pd_boot_ari              = pd_boot_ari,
        pd_boot_sil              = pd_boot_sil,
        pd_boot_ch               = pd_boot_ch,
        pd_status                = pd_status
      )

      saveRDS(boot_summary, boot_cache_file)
    }

    # Summarise this (embedding, k) into one row for the final table
    bootstrap_results[[length(bootstrap_results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      embedding                    = boot_summary$embedding,
      k                            = boot_summary$k,
      n_boot                       = boot_summary$n_boot,
      sample_fraction              = boot_summary$sample_fraction,
      pd_reference_silhouette      = boot_summary$pd_reference_silhouette,
      pd_reference_ch              = boot_summary$pd_reference_ch,
      pd_reference_prob_silh       = boot_summary$pd_reference_prob_silh,
      pd_bootstrap_ari_mean        = mean(boot_summary$pd_boot_ari,   na.rm = TRUE),
      pd_bootstrap_ari_sd          = sd(boot_summary$pd_boot_ari,     na.rm = TRUE),
      pd_bootstrap_ari_median      = median(boot_summary$pd_boot_ari, na.rm = TRUE),
      pd_bootstrap_sil_mean        = mean(boot_summary$pd_boot_sil,   na.rm = TRUE),
      pd_bootstrap_ch_mean         = mean(boot_summary$pd_boot_ch,    na.rm = TRUE),
      pd_valid_boot                = sum(is.finite(boot_summary$pd_boot_ari)),
      stringsAsFactors             = FALSE
    )
  }
}
```

# 5. Final table
```{r final}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# FINAL TABLE
# ------------------------------------------------------------
bootstrap_results_df <- bind_rows(bootstrap_results) %>%
  arrange(embedding, k)

print(bootstrap_results_df)

write.csv(
  bootstrap_results_df,
  file      = file.path(
    "output/bootstrap_stability_results",
    "bootstrap_stability_pd_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

# 6. Plot bootstrap stability
```{r plot-bootstrap-stability}
# Line plot of mean bootstrap ARI by k, faceted by embedding.
# Higher ARI = partitions on subsamples closely match the full-data partition.
ggplot(bootstrap_results_df, aes(x = k, y = pd_bootstrap_ari_mean)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_point(size = 2,    color = "steelblue") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = pd_bootstrap_ari_mean - pd_bootstrap_ari_sd,
      ymax = pd_bootstrap_ari_mean + pd_bootstrap_ari_sd
    ),
    width = 0.15, color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ embedding, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "PD Clustering Bootstrap Stability by Embedding and k",
    x     = "Number of clusters (k)",
    y     = "Mean bootstrap ARI (± 1 SD)"
  )
```

# 7. Inspect one cached bootstrap result
```{r inspect-one-bootstrap-run}
# Change these two values to inspect a different (embedding, k) pair
embedding_tag <- "user_embeddings_128"
k_val         <- 3

cache_file <- file.path(
  "output/bootstrap_stability_cache",
  paste0("bootstrap_pd_", embedding_tag, "_k", k_val, ".rds")
)

if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
  boot_obj <- readRDS(cache_file)

  inspect_df <- data.frame(
    replicate  = seq_len(boot_obj$n_boot),
    pd_ari     = boot_obj$pd_boot_ari,
    pd_sil     = boot_obj$pd_boot_sil,
    pd_ch      = boot_obj$pd_boot_ch,
    pd_status  = boot_obj$pd_status
  )

  print(inspect_df)
} else {
  cat("No bootstrap cache found for", embedding_tag, "k =", k_val, "\n")
}
```
